scope: Only finalized Cargo incremental unit directories; compiled dependencies and executables remain untouched.
selection_reason: All finalized Linux incremental cache units first; then the fewest largest exclusively allocated macOS units needed to reach approximately 8 GiB estimated reclaim. Linux validation VM and Kasumi Cargo builds are stopped according to coordinator.
protection_rules: Do not delete until coordinator review; confirm no Kasumi Cargo build has started.
Keep target directory roots and all target/debug/deps, target/linux-validation/debug/deps, rlib/rmeta, build outputs and validated/current executables.
Keep all source, manifests, benchmarks/results, logs, credentials, registry, tools and all release artifacts.
Only delete the exact selected finalized incremental unit directories; reject symlinks, paths outside the repository incremental roots, or newly appeared -working sessions.
Keep every unselected macOS incremental unit so a substantial local warm cache remains.
These are disposable recompilation caches; deleting them can cause future incremental recompilation but does not change current binaries.
The estimate counts an inode only when every known hard link is inside the selected set. APFS snapshots/clone allocation may reduce observed filesystem free-space gain.
